Source Bestiary 6 pg. 303, Pathfinder RPG Bestiary pg. 311, Bestiary 2 pg. 306, Bestiary 3 pg. 305, Bestiary 4 pg. 305, Bestiary 5 pg. 304
A creature with the cold subtype has immunity to cold and vulnerability to fire.
